candidates.claim: Telnet is enabled on sw-it-01 line vty 0 4 (transport input telnet and ssh), which the management policy forbids.
candidates.remediation: Remove telnet from the transport input of line vty 0 4 on sw-it-01 so that only ssh is permitted.

candidates.claim: The transport input of line vty 0 4 on sw-it-01 was modified from the approved baseline (telnet added to an ssh-only configuration) and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the sw-it-01 line vty 0 4 transport input change against the approved baseline and revert the telnet addition unless it is formally approved.
